entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager G2 0.2.5
entry.summary: **What is new in 0.2.5:** tap the storage readout at the top right to choose where new plugins go. With more than one place (the internal drive and an SSD or card, say) it names the drive (`CARD · 12.0 GB ▾`) and opens an **INSTALL TO** menu with each drive's free space; the choice is remembered. entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager G2 0.2.4
entry.summary: **What is new in 0.2.4:** the on-screen keyboard no longer types every letter twice, and buttons no longer fire twice. MPC delivers one tap as two presses 30 to 140 ms apart; the manager and the shared plugin wrapper now treat a second press of the same button within 250 ms as the same tap. Also from 0.2.3: zips in `local-plugins/` are listed with no network. (Called the OpenMPC Plugin Manager VST; the zip and plugin names still say "G2".) entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager G2 0.2.3
entry.summary: **What is new in 0.2.3:** zips you put in `local-plugins/` are now listed, and can be installed, with no network. If the catalog cannot be reached the manager says so in a small warning and still shows your local zips and what is installed. (Called the OpenMPC Plugin Manager VST; the zip and plugin names still say "G2".)
